records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, project created early (2026-08-18) and 1 invite sent, so there is real initial momentum. But no key milestone yet, no customer reply to welcome email [email:5241eb3d], and a no-show at the onboarding call [calendar:555175b6] suggests low current engagement; no tickets either way.

draft.subject: Picking back up where we left off
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Sorry we missed each other on Wednesday -- happy to find another time that suits you better.

You've got a project created in Wrenfield, which is a good start: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if it's useful to retrace the steps, and I'm glad to help with whatever comes next.

Would a short call this week work? Send me a couple of times and I'll make one fit.

Best,
Chidi
